instructions_to_main_agent: Follow this guideline strictly to build the idealand.ai landing page in React JS (frontend/src/App.js & components).
Maintain the airy, vibrant Sky Blue / Azure glassmorphism theme with tactile skeuominimalist buttons.
Do NOT turn the page into dark mode; keep the light sky-gradient aesthetic.
Ensure the hero chat bar has interactive prompt chips that pre-fill the input and lead to the waitlist email modal.
Implement the waitlist email capture connected to the MongoDB backend (/api/waitlist).
Add Lenis for smooth scrolling and Framer Motion for line-by-line hero entrance and card hover effects.
Include all required data-testid attributes on interactive elements.
